notes: Provider obstacles may overlap: the same game can fail multiple providers.
Rate-limit counts come from attempts, not distinct API-wide coverage.
No unresolved game is treated as an incorrect pick or a settled bet.

ft_queue.retry_policy: V7: changed list resets; identical complete lists at 4h/12h/24h; failed/rotated visits >=4h

limitations: A missing FT is not a lost wager or proof about goals.
A single provider FT is identified as single-source, not independent cross-verification.
Unmatched, conflicting, postponed and ambiguous fixtures remain unverified.
SportScore results with a provably reversed home-away URL are quarantined.
No betting ROI or predictive accuracy is computed; matches are the unit of analysis.
